definitions.explanation: The act of changing from one thing to another, such as switching systems, modes, or approaches.
Shifting one's mental focus or attitude, especially recovering from a setback.

examples.japanese: ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The system switchover will be done late at night.

examples.japanese: {夏時間|なつじかん}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The changeover to daylight saving time was implemented.

examples.japanese: ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}えます→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: You can switch screens with this button.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧だ。

examples.english: He's quick to put setbacks behind him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ほど⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Players who can quickly shift their mindset after a loss tend to grow more.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{替|か}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ - to carry out a switchover
- ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え - mental shift
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え - screen switching

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (IT, technical):
- ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え - system switchover
- {切|き}り{替|か}え⟦スイッチ→スイッチ：03848_suicchi⟧ - toggle switch
- ⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}→入力：04769_nyuuryoku⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え - input switching
- ⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧{切|き}り{替|か}え - language switching

USAGE:
The noun of {切|き}り{替|か}える; the verb is {切|き}り{替|か}える, not {切|き}り{替|か}え⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. In the mental sense it is praise in sports and work: the ability to recover from a mistake and refocus ({切|き}り{替|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧).

WRITING:
Also written {切|き}り{換|か}え; signs and labels often use {切替|きりかえ}.
